plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1806, Nov 1880 & 1900 (Thomas Andrew Knight's waterwheel, Charles and Francis Darwin prove the 1–2 mm grass tip senses light at Down House, and Gottlieb Haberlandt and Bohumil Němec discover falling-starch statolith gravity sensors in root caps) · 1913 & 17 Apr 1926 (Peter Boysen-Jensen proves the phototropic signal crosses gelatin on the shaded side, and Frits Warmolt Went isolates auxin in agar jelly at 3:00 a.m. in Utrecht) · 1901 & 29 Dec 1934 (Dmitry Neljubow discovers ethylene gas bends pea shoots in St Petersburg, and Richard Gane in Cambridge proves ripening apples manufacture ethylene hormone).

teach_overlay.scale: from tiny tin-foil helmets in Charles Darwin's greenhouse and a cube of jelly at three in the morning to a crate of apples in Cambridge, scientists proved that plants navigate the world without a single eye or nerve
